term_adjudication.one_vs_two_online_reading: Shidian and Xing received presentations both display 二日; CText OCR-like presentation displays 一日. This demonstrates web transcription instability. No physically bound edition target glyph is yet available to prove that either book has a historical variant.
term_adjudication.two_day_meaning: 二日對減 can refer to subtraction of the two tabular values indexed at adjacent days, which have a one-day separation. 二日 here does NOT, on its own, warrant a mechanically assumed two-full-day elapsed interval.
term_adjudication.not_proven: This bounded compatibility does not prove original Yuan punctuation, Xing-to-Huang direct borrowing, same physical recension, the exact historical endpoint indexing convention, or G893 table production and carried precision.
term_adjudication.prior_13SY_wording_correction: Replace any reading of 'two-day linear fractional-time interpolation' as a two-whole-day span with the narrower 'two adjacent daily endpoint values' interpretation when applying the already documented received alternative operator. Preserve 13SY research record; do not silently rewrite it.

exact_integer_certificate.scale: C and M are already registered integer scaled 10^8 degree in 13SU. The coefficient-based difference is an exact identity, not newly obtained source-original numerics.
exact_integer_certificate.conditional_interpolation: C(n)+f*M(n)=(1-f)*C(n)+f*C(n+1), where 0<=f<1. This is the exact algebra of consecutive-day tabular endpoints in the 13SU model; source-native ancient quantization and G893 epoch/carry remain unproved.
exact_integer_certificate.scale_caution: Do not treat these integers as a newly read G893 source original or a historical standalone definition of 少.

unproved: Ming Xing vs Qing Huang same reading does not prove direct borrowing
